_purpose: FOURTH sourcing channel for Kelvi's DevOps/SRE/Platform/Cloud job hunt: third-party firms and job boards that hire INTO A FOREIGN COUNTRY with work-visa sponsorship / relocation for a non-EU, India-passport candidate. Two kinds live here: (a) country-targeted international job boards that explicitly flag visa-sponsorship / relocation roles (daijob.com for Japan is the archetype), and (b) cross-border relocation-focused recruitment agencies that place overseas candidates into sponsored roles. This is NOT the India-domestic recruiter registry (see recruiters.json), NOT direct employers (companies.json), NOT India job boards (platforms.json). Manual profile-registration + targeted-application registry, same posture as recruiters.json.
_priority: Rank BELOW recruiters.json (the India priority channel, per Kelvi 2026-09-03) unless/until Kelvi says he is actively pursuing relocation. Within this file, work P1 first. Purpose of the channel: surface visa-sponsored overseas DevOps/SRE/Cloud roles that never appear on India boards, and get one profile in front of many relocation-friendly employers at once.

_priorityModel.P1: Tech-focused board that explicitly filters for visa sponsorship / relocation, OR a relocation recruiter with a real DevOps/SRE/Cloud flow, covering a target country, with an open candidate path (search or free profile signup). Register + run searches first.
_priorityModel.P2: Relevant but generalist, OR candidate path unclear / employer-pays-only agency, OR country is secondary. Register where a portal exists, else a short intro.
_priorityModel.P3: Government info portal with no direct apply, low-yield body-shop consultancy, nationality/onshore-restricted board, or unverified. Light touch; revisit if a specific role appears.

_kindLegend.intl-jobboard: Job board aimed at international candidates for one country/region, with a visa-sponsorship or relocation filter/tag.
_kindLegend.relocation-recruiter: Agency that recruits candidates in one country to place them (with sponsorship) in another. Paid by the employer — if it asks Kelvi for a placement fee, that is a red flag, stop and tell him.
_kindLegend.aggregator: Cross-country curated list/board of relocation-friendly tech roles.
_kindLegend.govt-portal: Government or quasi-government job/immigration portal — authoritative for the visa route, variable as a live job source.
_kindLegend.targeting-tool: Not a job source itself — an official register (recognised sponsors, accredited employers, shortage-occupation list) used to filter which employers/roles are worth pursuing.

_statusLegend.Verified: Public contact email found on the entity's own site at compile time — safe to email (re-verify, addresses move).
_statusLegend.Portal: Runs a public candidate job-search / profile-registration portal — use that.
_statusLegend.Form: No public email and no real candidate portal — reach via a site enquiry form.
_statusLegend.LinkedIn: Best reached by following + connecting with its recruiters on LinkedIn.
_statusLegend.InfoOnly: Information / route-reference only; no candidate-facing apply path.

_howThisFeedsTheMechanism.channels: companies.json = direct career portals (company-portals skill). platforms.json = LinkedIn + India job boards (job-platforms skill). recruiters.json = India third-party staffing firms (recruiter-outreach skill, priority). relocation.json = this file, overseas visa-sponsorship boards + relocation recruiters (visa-relocation skill).
_howThisFeedsTheMechanism.automationStatus: No script reads this file and the 3x/day cloud routine does NOT act on it yet. Making it a live 4th search step in the routine needs a /schedule (RemoteTrigger) prompt change + adding data/relocation.json to the routine's GitHub fetch list — exactly the same pending change described for recruiters.json in ROUTINE.md. Until then, visa-relocation is a manual/assisted workflow.
_howThisFeedsTheMechanism.keepInSync: profile.json = source of truth for target roles / seniority. APPLY-REFERENCE.md = source of truth for identity/contact answers on registration forms. Do not restate those here.

_candidateContext.passport: India — non-EU/non-EEA for every European entry here. B.Tech (CSE) satisfies the 'recognised degree' test for the EU Blue Card and for Ireland's Critical Skills permit.
_candidateContext.experience: ~2.5 yrs full-time DevOps/SRE + 2 internships — mid-level. Clears most specialist/skilled thresholds; below any 'senior specialist / high-earner' fast lanes.
_candidateContext.watchOuts: A board's 'visa sponsorship' tag is the employer's claim at post time — verify on the JD and with the employer; some offers are nationality-restricted or need the role to clear a salary floor. Gulf visas are employer-tied and not portable. Never pay a recruiter a placement fee (employer-paid is the norm) without Kelvi's explicit decision.

_sources: User instruction, 2026-09-03 — 'add a 4th channel: third-party firms hiring for another country, like daijob.com for Japan' with the target-country shortlist above.

Web research, 2026-09-03 — international/visa-sponsorship job boards and relocation recruiters per target country. Domains and 'visa filter' claims are best-effort; re-verify each entity's current candidate path and that it still flags sponsorship before outreach.

entries.name: Relocate.me
entries.notes: Hand-curated tech-only board where every listing carries a relocation-package + visa-sponsorship breakdown. Works with candidates from 150+ countries; Estonia-based. Best single starting point for this channel. Free tier + a paid 'The Global Move' archive (5000+ curated roles) — treat the paid gate as P2.

entries.name: The Global Move (Relocate.me)
entries.notes: Andrew Stetsenko's curated 5000+ visa-sponsorship tech-job archive; partly paid. Flag the spend to Kelvi before paying. Companion open list: github.com/AndrewStetsenko/tech-jobs-with-relocation (free, less fresh).

entries.name: Honeypot.io
entries.notes: Reverse-recruiting: companies apply to you. DACH + NL + ES focus, relocation-support flagged per role. Admits ~10% of applicants — a curated profile is the ask, not per-role applications.

entries.name: WorkBeyond
entries.notes: Aggregates visa-sponsored roles across Europe / North America / Asia / Australia. Not tech-only — filter hard. Newer; verify listing freshness.

entries.name: Jaabz
entries.notes: Global tech board specialising in visa-sponsorship + relocation + remote; claims 2500+ companies. Relatively new — verify a sample of listings resolve to real, current reqs before relying on it.

entries.name: EURES (EU job mobility portal)
entries.notes: Official EU-wide vacancy portal; some listings are explicitly open to non-EU applicants. Authoritative for which country runs which permit. Job feed is generalist — use the 'EU Blue Card' and sector filters.

entries.name: Jobbatical
entries.notes: Immigration/relocation platform (Estonia roots) — now mostly employer-side (they process visas for 1000+ companies across 45+ countries). Limited candidate-facing job feed; value is knowing which employers use them = relocation-ready. Approach via the contact form or LinkedIn.

entries.name: talent.io
entries.notes: Curated dev hiring marketplace (FR/DE/UK/NL/ES/BE). Relocation/sponsorship not a first-class filter — confirm per employer. One vetted profile, companies reach out.

entries.name: Arbeitnow
entries.notes: Berlin-based board with explicit visa-sponsorship + English-speaking + relocation filters; strong tech/startup volume (Zalando, N26, HelloFresh, B2B SaaS). Has a public jobs API. Primary Germany entry.

entries.name: EnglishJobs.de
entries.notes: English-speaking roles across Germany with a dedicated visa-sponsorship section. Not tech-only — filter to DevOps/SRE/Cloud.

entries.name: JobsForExpats.de
entries.notes: Built for internationals moving to Germany — filters for visa sponsorship, relocation packages, English-friendly, open-to-abroad. Verify current listing volume.

entries.name: Germany Is Calling (GIC)
entries.notes: Curated visa-sponsored job board + CV-analysis tooling for internationals. Domain best-effort — confirm before use.

entries.name: Berlin Startup Jobs
entries.notes: English-language Berlin startup/scale-up roles; many sponsor Blue Cards but it is not a first-class filter — check each JD for 'relocation / visa'.

entries.name: IamExpat Jobs (Netherlands)
entries.notes: The established job board for internationals in NL; has a highly-skilled-migrant / relocation angle. Also runs IamExpat Germany. Filter to IT.

entries.name: Together Abroad
entries.notes: Job board + career services for international job seekers in the Netherlands. Generalist; verify sponsorship per role.

entries.name: Undutchables
entries.notes: Recruitment agency specialising in internationals / multilingual candidates for NL employers; handles the highly-skilled-migrant process. IT desk exists but is not their core — verify.

entries.name: IND Public Register of Recognised Sponsors
entries.notes: Official list of NL employers licensed to sponsor a Highly Skilled Migrant. Only these companies can hire Kelvi directly — use it to filter every NL lead (and to seed companies.json). Booking.com, Adyen, Databricks, Optiver are active sponsors (add as companies, cross-ref).

entries.name: Recruitroo
entries.notes: Specialises in relocating non-EU tech workers to Ireland end-to-end (recruitment + Critical Skills Employment Permit + relocation). DevOps explicitly in scope. Employer-paid. Register interest via the site.

entries.name: SoftwarePlacements.ie
entries.notes: Irish tech recruiter with a published non-EU relocation guide. Smaller; permanent placement. Verify live DevOps/SRE reqs.

entries.name: Ireland Critical Skills Occupations List
entries.notes: Confirms DevOps/SRE/Cloud sit on the Critical Skills list (2-yr permit, fast PR). Salary floor ~EUR 40k+ (rises yearly — re-check). US tech HQs in Dublin sponsor CSEP at scale — target them via companies.json.

entries.name: GulfTalent
entries.notes: Leading Gulf professional board; skews verified mid-to-senior. Employers expect to sponsor an expat work permit as standard, so an explicit 'visa' tag is rare — sponsorship is the default. Filter to DevOps/SRE/Cloud + UAE/KSA/Qatar.

entries.name: Bayt
entries.notes: Largest MENA CV database + board. High volume, more noise than GulfTalent. A searchable profile draws recruiter inbound for Gulf sponsored roles.

entries.name: Naukrigulf
entries.notes: Naukri's Gulf arm — explicitly oriented to India-to-Gulf hiring, so the pipeline and expectations match Kelvi's profile well. Reuse the Naukri profile identity (see platforms.json).

entries.name: Tiger Recruitment (Tiger Technology)
entries.notes: Dubai tech-hiring desk that explicitly recruits DevOps + cloud staff, including relocating candidates. Employer-paid.

entries.name: Robert Walters UAE
entries.notes: Permanent + contract tech desk in Dubai — Software Engineering, Cloud & Infrastructure, Cybersecurity. Relocates regional + international candidates. Robert Walters also runs Singapore (see below).

entries.name: SVA Recruitment
entries.notes: IT recruitment agency that explicitly sources candidates from India (and Ukraine) into Dubai + Qatar tech roles — a direct India->Gulf DevOps path. Employer-paid.

entries.name: Lucky Hunter
entries.notes: Dubai/MENA IT recruitment agency; has placed DevOps roles. Smaller — verify current desk activity.

entries.name: NADIA Global
entries.notes: Long-established UAE staffing incl. Cloud & DevOps Engineers. Generalist parent; IT is one desk.

entries.name: daijob.com
entries.notes: Kelvi's archetype for this channel. Bilingual (EN/JP) board for international professionals in Japan; many roles are visa-sponsoring and some accept applicants from abroad. Not tech-only — filter to IT/DevOps/SRE. Register an English profile.

entries.name: Japan Dev
entries.notes: Hand-picked English-speaking software/tech jobs in Japan, 'no Japanese required', explicitly filters for visa sponsorship FROM OVERSEAS and companies that help with relocation. Best-fit Japan entry for Kelvi.

entries.name: TokyoDev
entries.notes: Curated English-speaking developer jobs in Japan; the large majority are visa-sponsoring. Strong for backend/infra/SRE at internationally-minded Japanese companies.

entries.name: GaijinPot Jobs
entries.notes: Broad jobs-for-foreigners board in Japan (teaching-heavy, but a real IT section). Visa-status filter exists. Lower tech signal than Japan Dev / TokyoDev.

entries.name: CareerCross
entries.notes: Bilingual-professional board in Japan; recruiter-agency listings heavy. Verify sponsorship per role.

entries.name: Jobs in Japan
entries.notes: Generalist foreigner-in-Japan board with a visa-sponsorship filter. IT present but thin vs the dev-specific boards.

entries.name: JETRO 'Open for Professionals' (OFP)
entries.notes: Japanese government (JETRO) list of 270+ companies that have declared themselves open to foreign professionals. Use to seed direct targets for companies.json / the Japan boards.

entries.name: Landing.jobs
entries.notes: Portugal-based tech-only board with an explicit visa & work-permit filter and vetted relocation/remote support; heaviest in Lisbon/Porto, also DE/NL/other Western EU. Primary Portugal entry; strong secondary for Spain. Portugal Tech Visa (govt) speeds approvals for listed employers.

entries.name: Jobfluent
entries.notes: English-language startup jobs in Spain (Barcelona/Madrid). Sponsorship not a first-class filter — Spain's Highly Qualified Professional permit + Startup Law route is fast for listed scale-ups; confirm per employer.

entries.name: TecnoEmpleo
entries.notes: Largest Spanish IT board but overwhelmingly local / Spanish-language / no-sponsorship. Low yield for a non-EU relocation; listed for completeness.

entries.name: NoFluffJobs
entries.notes: Transparent-salary IT board across CEE (PL core, also CZ/SK/HU). Has an English UI and a relocation/'fully remote' filter; some employers sponsor Type A + temp-residence for non-EU. Verify sponsorship per JD.

entries.name: JustJoin.it
entries.notes: Largest Poland IT board; salary + tech-stack transparent, English UI, has a relocation-package flag. Kraków/Warsaw/Wrocław GCC + product volume. Confirm the employer sponsors non-EU.

entries.name: StartupJobs.cz
entries.notes: Czech/Slovak startup + tech board with an English UI. Czech Republic is an active EU Blue Card issuer; confirm sponsorship per employer.

entries.name: Work in Estonia
entries.notes: Estonian government relocation portal for international talent — IT-heavy job board + step-by-step visa/relocation guidance + Startup Visa info. Primary Estonia entry.

entries.name: MeetFrank
entries.notes: Estonia-built anonymous job-matching app; strong Baltics + broader EU tech, surfaces relocation-flagged roles. App-first — set target role + relocation-open in the profile.

entries.name: MobiTalents
entries.notes: Job board specifically for tech/IT relocation to Sweden, Finland and Norway. Primary Nordics entry.

entries.name: The Hub
entries.notes: Nordic startup/scale-up job board (Danske Bank + founder-backed). English throughout; many list relocation. Confirm sponsorship per role.

entries.name: Nordic Jobs Worldwide
entries.notes: Recruitment agency that relocates international / multilingual candidates into Nordic employers, including IT. Employer-paid. Register a candidate profile.

entries.name: Work in Denmark (Workindenmark)
entries.notes: Danish government portal for non-EU professionals — job bank + the Positive List / Pay Limit / Fast-track routes. Denmark is a top pick for English-only candidates; primary Denmark entry. jobsinenglish.dk is a private complement.

entries.name: Demando
entries.notes: Swedish tech-talent marketplace, companies apply to candidates. Sweden work-permit is relatively straightforward via employer; confirm per role.

entries.name: Work in Finland (Business Finland / Talent Boost)
entries.notes: Finnish government talent portal — specialist permit (D-visa fast-track ~2 weeks) info + job listings. Primary Finland entry.

entries.name: Robert Walters Singapore
entries.notes: MOM-licensed tech desk (cloud/infra/software). Sponsors Employment Pass for experienced hires. Register + name target roles.

entries.name: NodeFlair
entries.notes: Singapore/SEA tech jobs + salary transparency. EP is employer-sponsored (min ~SGD 5,600/mo, COMPASS points) — confirm the employer will sponsor before investing.

entries.name: Second Talent
entries.notes: Places software engineers from around SEA into Singapore companies; some remote-for-SG. Verify EP-sponsorship appetite per client.

entries.name: Morgan McKinley Singapore
entries.notes: Tech + fintech recruitment in SG; also has a Dublin/Ireland tech desk. Mid-to-senior contingency perm.

entries.name: Working In New Zealand
entries.notes: Relocation-focused jobs + visa + settlement portal with a dedicated ICT stream. Primary NZ entry for the AEWV / Green List route.

entries.name: NZ Green List (Immigration NZ)
entries.notes: Software Engineer is a Tier-1 Green List role = straight-to-residence pathway. Confirms Kelvi's target is in scope; use with the accredited-employer register (only accredited employers can grant an AEWV).

entries.name: Seek New Zealand
entries.notes: Main NZ board (also Seek Australia). Cross-check each employer against the Immigration NZ accredited-employer list before applying.

entries.name: Absolute IT / Potentia / Talent International (NZ)
entries.notes: NZ specialist IT recruiters that handle relocating offshore candidates for accredited employers. Register with one or two, not all.

entries.name: NES Fircroft
entries.notes: Large engineering/technical staffing firm mobilising international contractors into Gulf megaprojects (NEOM, Red Sea Global) — full visa + relocation + mobilisation handling. Cloud/DevOps demand is high there. Employer-paid.

entries.name: SaviorHire
entries.notes: IT staffing / tech recruitment across KSA + Gulf — staff-aug, EOR, exec search. Verify a live DevOps/SRE desk.

entries.name: ZeroTaxJobs
entries.notes: Niche board for tax-free (mostly Gulf) software/tech jobs — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Doha, Riyadh. Smaller volume; sponsorship is the Gulf default.

entries.name: Avensys Consulting
entries.notes: IT recruitment + consulting (SG HQ, KSA desk). Verify current relevance before outreach.

entries.name: Deltareco
entries.notes: India-based overseas recruitment agency — Gulf, Europe, Asia. Multi-sector (oil/gas/construction/healthcare/IT); IT/DevOps yield is thin. Employer-paid — do NOT pay a candidate fee. Light touch.

entries.name: Ambe International
entries.notes: One of India's oldest licensed overseas recruitment agencies (since 1983), Gulf-focused. Mostly non-IT; check for a live tech mandate before engaging. Employer-paid only.

entries.name: GlobeSkills International
entries.notes: India (Kolkata) overseas agency — Gulf + some EU (Poland/Croatia/Lithuania/Romania) + SG/MY. Generalist; verify an IT desk. Employer-paid.

entries.name: Jaleel International
entries.notes: India (Mumbai) overseas recruitment agency, Middle East + Europe + Asia. Multi-sector, low tech signal. Employer-paid only — decline any candidate-side fee.
